description: Add a comment (note) to a Sentry issue's activity feed, visible to the whole team. Use it to record findings or decisions; never post secrets or credentials.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

text.description: The comment text, posted as is.

name: add_issue_note
title: Add Issue Note
